items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: They had a guy at the door, old Jones at the door, yelling ladies and gentlemen there.

ctx.x: And they had to be first class. They had a guy at the door, old Jones at the door, yelling ladies and gentlemen there. And I worked with a fellow named Ollie Powers. What a voice.
He had a very high voice.
